scope: finite symbolic devices, materials, resources and declared environment; no geometry or real equipment

controller.order: activation eligible tick, static node ID, numeric loop path
controller.activation: new tokens become eligible at current_tick+1
controller.reads: conditions/preconditions/holds read the controller snapshot; atomic grants recheck live capacity and conflicts
controller.failure: global failure prevents subsequent submissions and reconciles all already activated children
controller.scope_exit: normal scope exits only after its child succeeded, actual stop, and matching stop evidence

device_hold: Check capability sustaining conditions before every physical action phase, even before acceptance is observed; on failure halt progress, publish a held fault and schedule physical stop. Controller reconciles on fault receipt or its own hold/timeout check.

timing.physical_interval: choose delta in [min,max] on stage entry; due=start+delta-1 (inclusive start tick)
timing.next_physical_stage: start=current_tick+1, independent of when the controller observes acceptance
timing.sampling: source publishes a held phase value after its physical event and samples each tick while receiver is interested
timing.delivery: choose latency in profile interval at each sample; due=sample_tick+1+latency; per-stream FIFO blocks later packets behind earlier ones
timing.deadline: delivery/controller confirmation at the deadline tick precedes expiry evaluation
timing.no_fairness: no guaranteed eventual fresh arrival if allowed latency can exceed freshness

faults.budget: at most max_faults; no-fault successor remains available; latency choices do not spend fault budget
faults.packet_fault_choices: any currently queued packet, not only the queue head; preserve its sampling time and payload except the declared old identity replacement
faults.duplicate: copy is immediately eligible on injection tick, still respects FIFO
faults.restart: increment actor epoch, clear actor latches and pending receipts, abort and reconcile; preserve material effects
faults.permission_loss: only changes actor permit; controller reacts through declared hold rules
faults.stop_ack_loss: suppresses stop confirmation but not the bounded physical stop

external_events.set_external: updates declared exogenous state; current world snapshots may resample the state without rewriting an old packet
external_events.replace_carrier: wait for no active request involving carrier/slots, no conflicting grants, no reservations or held material, and free destination capacity

terminal_closure: all children settled and no outstanding physical event; attention retains required isolation; no automatic physical rollback or recovery
response_obligation: first valid acceptance time is retained; confirmed protocol outcome or qualified isolation is a response; packet freshness is checked at ingestion and does not get a fabricated new sample time
property_scope: P1 predicates plus explicit state-based V10b lifetime monitoring; whole-model answers require P3 evidence checks
pilot_mapping: versioned migration: embedded accept/phase/stop ranges become physical-stage durations, feedback latency [0,0], visibility 1; not asserted equivalent to old synchronous microsteps
